fast.change: Added tracking for file/directory creation and conditional initialization message.
fast.impact: Changes the success message behavior to provide more accurate feedback when re-running initialization.

detailed.change: The logic now introduces a boolean flag 'created_anything' which aggregates the success status of all file and directory creation operations. The original implementation unconditionally printed a 'successfully initialized' message even if the directory structure already existed. By checking the return values of 'create_file' and tracking directory mkdir actions, the function now differentiates between a fresh setup and an operation performed on an existing environment.
detailed.impact: The user experience is improved by preventing misleading success messages when no actual changes were made to the file system. It avoids reporting a successful initialization when the environment was already present, providing more explicit feedback via an info message instead of the previous celebratory terminal output.
detailed.risk: The refactoring relies on 'create_file' returning a consistent boolean indicating file creation status. If 'create_file' behavior changes, logic might misreport. Severity is negligible as this is purely UI/UX feedback logic with no side effects on data integrity. low
